comparison.objective: Hold a skewer, align four food pieces with its point, thread them on, then return the skewer to the grill.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rod stabilization and repeated hole-on-rod insertion; it lacks impact fracture and independent recovery of released pieces.
comparison.success_condition: All four pieces are threaded onto the skewer, which is laid back across the grill and released. Numeric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared coaxial-alignment primitive, but its tested outcome is repeated assembly onto a rod, not breaking notched tangs while preserving coils and containing debris.
